name: git
description: Run sandboxed git commands on the project. Input: {"args": ["status", "--porcelain"]}. Allowed: status, diff, log, show, add, commit, ls-files, rev-parse, branch. Destructive commands (push, reset, rebase, checkout, clean, rm, fetch, merge, revert, stash) are denied. Returns {"ok": bool, "code": int, "stdout": "...", "stderr": "..."}.
